description: Arrêts de bus Communauté d'Agglomération le Grand Narbonne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservice.siglr.org. Bus stops located as points. Network January 2017 + Updated several times a year - Communauté d'Agglomération le Grand Narbonne. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Bus stops Communauté d'Agglomération le Grand Narbonne" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, Bus, arrêts, abris bus, transports en commun, lignes. The listing shows 2019-06-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
